concerns.text: The primary analysis pipeline is executed in **Synthetic Verification Mode** by default, generating mock rs‑fMRI data and artificial training histories. While this validates code correctness, it cannot provide evidence about the real-world relationship between musical training and functional connectivity, which is the core research question. Relying on synthetic data to satisfy FR‑001 and to draw any scientific conclusions makes the methodology unsound.

The plan redefines the musician group to require **≥ 2 years** of training (see FR‑001 entry) whereas the specification (FR‑001) mandates a **≥ 1 year** threshold. This inconsistency alters the construct being measured without justification, threatening construct validity and comparability to prior literature.
